Intuitive Machines Inc (NASDAQ:LUNR) shares recovered on Thursday, rising about 4% to $14.58 after Wednesday's sell-off, as space stocks stabilized.

Intuitive Machines announced Thursday that it has signed a new lunar delivery contract with a commercial customer. The company said the mission is scheduled for 2028. Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ:SPCX) remained a launch provider for the mission.

The SpaceX debt financing is now expected to close in the first quarter of 2027, earlier than the previously reported timeline, according to people familiar with the deal.

Intuitive Machines shares remain well below their recent highs, and analysts say the stock is trading on sentiment linked to SpaceX rather than its own fundamentals.
headline: Intuitive Machines Rebounds Thursday After New Lunar Delivery Contract
summary: Intuitive Machines rose about 4% to $14.58 after announcing a new 2028 lunar delivery contract, as space stocks steadied.
